node.title: L=1 four-coordinate block-owner ledger: C1-ZERO is exactly '64 structured targets attract at most 3+1/q excess weighted relation mass over Haar'
node.statement: At L=1 (N=256, omega of exact order 512), partition coordinates into 64 four-blocks; with K_j the weighted ternary difference fibre, kappa_j the block difference measure (mass 16, kappa_j(0)=1 by the banked weight<=4 exclusions), A_j = new first-owner relation mass at block j, the exact telescoping identity holds: Z - 2^256/q = 1 - 1/q + sum_j (A_j - 15*2^(4j)/q). Hence C1-ZERO at L=1 is EXACTLY equivalent to sum_j (A_j - 15*2^(4j)/q) <= 3 + 1/q: the 64 structured four-bit targets may attract at most ~3 units of weighted relation mass beyond Haar. This is an exact accounting identity localizing the inverse-flatness mystery; it bounds nothing, and does not prove C1-ZERO, SWIF-4, CERP, L>1, or either Prize result. Provenance: Pro inverse-flatness strategy (notes/pro_briefs_20260801/responses/blackhole/), audited and replayed 2026-08-01 (verifier: 64-block replay at q=7681, exact rationals).
